messages:
Eric (CTO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — leadership greenlit the FY26 headcount envelope. posting the short playbook here and opening this thread for clarifying Qs: https://redwood.example.com/hr/fy26-playbook :slightly_smiling_face:

Ana (People Ops): sharing the spreadsheet summary in the doc. we captured hires by bucket and an initial timeline. will publish the req template and the intake form by EOD.

Jamie L: thanks. top-level q: when do managers get approval to create reqs? can they start drafting role descriptions now or wait for final bands/levels?

Ana (People Ops): managers can draft now. approvals will be in two phases — budget ok (this playbook) then final comp bands/level sign-off. recruiters will not open roles in GH until comp bands posted (target: next Tue).

Sanjay R: are there any hard freezes for infra/geography? we have a backlog for Dedicated infra engineers and want to prioritize those hires.

Eric (CTO): prioritization: customer-facing infra (Dedicated & Private) and reliability work are top of funnel for Q1. no geographic freezes but hiring for certain regions will require legal/relocation checks. ping me if you need an exception.

Katie - Eng: will there be internal transfers prioritized vs external hires? a few ICs on my team are interested in cross-team moves.

Ana (People Ops): yes — internal mobility is first-class. managers should add internal candidates to the intake form and note "internal":true. recruiters will do parallel searches but put internal mobility at higher priority.

Jamie L: clarify scope of the reorg note from the all-hands — are we consolidating two platform squads into one or just aligning goals?

Eric (CTO): it's alignment, not headcount reduction. Goal is to merge overlapping responsibilities so we reduce context-switching. the two squads keep their headcounts but will report to a single platform director for next 6 months to iterate on boundaries.

Sanjay R: any changes to oncall staffing expectations tied to hires?

Ana (People Ops): no immediate policy changes. as we hire, team leads should update their oncall rotations in the shared SRE sheet. ops lead will post recommendations next week.

Jamie L: can we get a one-pager on what "priority buckets" mean and how to request re-prioritization? managers will need a clear escalation path.

Ana (People Ops): yes — working on a short FAQ and a request workflow. interim process: submit the intake form and add a note with "priority: urgent"; leadership will review weekly.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: intake form link -> https://redwood.example.com/hr/intake (auto-posted)

Katie - Eng: do we have guidance on interview panel composition for new roles? wants to avoid panel overload across teams.

Ana (People Ops): we'll publish recommended panels per bucket (infra/platform/product) and suggested maximum panel time (60-75 mins). default: 3 interviewers + hiring manager.

Sanjay R: thanks — for Dedicated infra, i'll start drafting 3 reqs and flag them as high priority. any naming convention we should use?

Ana (People Ops): please use prefix `DED-` for tracking, e.g., `DED-infra-engineer-1`. that'll help reporting.

Eric (CTO): appreciate the questions. follow-ups: i'll be on this thread for the next hour, and Ana will collect action items. if anything requires a private sync please DM. :thumbsup:
